sloka: कदनं तरसा कृत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो वनौकसाम्।आससाद ततो युद्धे राघवं त्वरितस्तदा ।। ६.९७.५ ।।
transliteration: kadanaṁ tarasā kṛtvā rākṣasendro vanaukasām।āsasāda tato yuddhe rāghavaṁ tvaritastadā ।। 6.97.5 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king, having destroyed the forest rangers, thereafter, went to Raghava hurriedly.
